title: Prerequisite learning planner
job: Find a minimum-time learning path from current mastery and prerequisite constraints to a declared goal.
method: Exact mastery-state dynamic programming over declared activity contracts.
recovery: Add a missing prerequisite activity or revise the time budget; do not infer mastery from a plan.
acceptance: A cheap activity cannot bypass an unmet prerequisite; already-mastered concepts need no repeat work.
novelty_scope: Algorithms and domain operations have established prior art. The evaluated contribution is the bounded executable resource and small-model integration, not invention of the underlying task.

problem_evidence.evidence: User requested inexpensive AI resources that improve completion of specific domain jobs.
The linked existing tools and their manuals document the recurring task and established solutions. No user interview or unmeasured frustration count is invented.

nearest_alternatives.name: Moodle Quiz
nearest_alternatives.capability: Question bank, quiz setup and assessment
nearest_alternatives.burden: Learning platform; not a close workforce scheduling alternative
nearest_alternatives.evidence_status: primary page read; exact feature parity not fully executed

nearest_alternatives.name: Google OR-Tools
nearest_alternatives.capability: Scheduling, constraint optimization, flows and routing
nearest_alternatives.burden: Solver installation and problem modeling; broader and more scalable than bounded in-browser search
nearest_alternatives.evidence_status: primary page read; exact feature parity not fully executed

nearest_alternatives.name: Manual or composed workflow
nearest_alternatives.capability: A person follows the rules with a spreadsheet, scripts and tool documentation
nearest_alternatives.burden: Repeated setup, arithmetic, checks and trace keeping; actual human time savings have not been measured

queries: prerequisite learning path minimum time mastery planning 선행학습 경로
research_scope.scope: Primary documentation and repository descriptions were read on the public web. Competitor code, plugins and packaged execution were not exhaustively tested. This is a bounded prior-art review, not a worldwide novelty search.
limitations: Search results and documentation do not establish universal absence.
Competitor configuration/plugin parity is not exhausted.
No independent end-user interview or deployment evidence.
proposed_queries: 현재 숙련도와 선행 조건에서 목표를 달성하는 최소 학습 시간 경로를 찾는다.
research_scope.query_scope: One actual bilingual search per resource, grouped in shared cached batches; additional suggested terms are explicitly proposed, not executed.

distinctive_capability: Exact mastery-state dynamic programming over declared activity contracts. An offline executable can be called by a small model and checked against an explicit task contract.
counterevidence: Underlying algorithms and task outcomes already exist in the alternatives.
An existing tool configured for this exact task may remove the need for a separate project.
Small synthetic tests cannot establish broad expertise or external demand.
validation_hypothesis: The same small model completes the held-out structured job more accurately with this executable resource than without it.

prototype_budget.note: Shared implementation/research/test/publication budget is tracked at batch level; not a claim of actual elapsed work.

stop_conditions: Existing configured tool gives the same accessibility and integration benefit
An invariant fails on real input

validation_results.fixture_role: Development regression fixtures; not an untouched final model evaluation set.

decision.reason: Independent task implementation and local regression pass. Publication is for feedback; no flagship or external-impact certification.

input_contract.money: Declared decimal strings; exact minor-unit results are strings
input_contract.reference: cases.json gives the complete normal and edge-case structures

execution.side_effects: Pure computation: no payments, deployments, outbound messages or file writes.
